source: DIG 18 default room-map module: public-only map run3 (-> run1 via b2_align_run3), a13 + C10 tilt, C9 gate 5.0 mm, keyframes every 5 + VO v2 forward/backward bridge; reads no GT
convention: mocap rotation (C10-corrected gravity), z; x,y = map coords (per-episode constant offset vs the dataset, irrelevant to the slot-0-aligned scorer); R_wc columns = right/down/forward of the UNDISTORTED pinhole image (a1); c = ego_cam_c (mono time base), a = ego_cam_a at its own (earlier) capture time; keyframe = trusted | trusted_gate | rejected | null (bridged frame); bridge = frames to the nearest trusted keyframe
